description: Update the test suites to match the removed Name wheel while proving the To Die sit-out draw still works and old backups with a populated wheel object still load. Depends on FEAT-002. Keep both suites green (python unittest discover + node tests/test_ui.cjs) and add explicit coverage for the removal and the backward-compat guarantee.
steps: tests/test_ui.cjs: KEEP and verify the To Die sit-out draw assertions still pass. The harness currently asserts after r2-done that tab==='wheel' and wheelMode==='round2', then calls sitoutWheelPage() and checks the sit-out names, and separately asserts sitoutWheelPage() includes 'Two sit out. Six play.'. If FEAT-002 changed the sit-out screen key (e.g. from 'wheel' to 'sitout') or changed how progressRound2 sets tab, update these assertions to the new key/behavior so they still exercise the real sit-out draw. The sit-out draw rendering and content assertions MUST remain.

tests/test_ui.cjs: REMOVE assertions that exercise the deleted standalone Name wheel: the block that sets wheelMode='free', calls wheelModeTabs() and asserts data-wheel-mode='free'/'round2' tabs, and the block that forces randomIndex and calls spinWheel() asserting wheelLast and that no API call happens. Remove those cleanly (and any now-unused fixture setup for them) without disturbing the To Live per-game split assertions (round('round1') teams-grid, r1-reroll, no per-player team select) which are unrelated to the Name wheel and must stay. If wheelModeTabs()/spinWheel() were deleted in FEAT-002, any test referencing them must go.

tests/test_ui.cjs: ADD an assertion that the Name wheel is gone from navigation: evaluate the top-level `tabs` array (vm.runInContext) and assert it does NOT contain an entry with key 'wheel' NOR label 'Name wheel'; and assert renderRoom() output (or the tabs list) produces no data-open="wheel" Name-wheel room. Also assert there is no 'Name your fate' string produced by the content dispatcher for any navigable tab.

tests/test_tournament.py: KEEP test_wheel_large_lists_migration_and_validation, test_legacy_round2_archive_and_current_save_preservation, and the HTTP test_persistence_and_revision_conflict (which sends wheel.text) green — these ALREADY prove the engine keeps the inert wheel field and that old backups load. Do not weaken them. If FEAT-002 left engine.py unchanged (recommended), they pass as-is. Only touch them if engine behavior changed, and if so keep their intent (old backups with wheel still validate/load).

tests/test_tournament.py: ADD a focused backward-compat test (e.g. in the Rules class) that constructs a state via new_state(), sets a populated s['wheel']={'text':'Aaron\nGhost\nJay','remove_winner':True}, round-trips through json.dumps/loads, calls validate(), and asserts the wheel object survives and evaluate() runs without error. Also assert new_state() itself validates (schema version 4) and that a backup dict WITHOUT a 'wheel' key still validates (wheel defaults to {'text':'','remove_winner':False}).

Do NOT attempt to run or fix tests/test_browser.cjs (Playwright not installed here and the file references unrelated/partly-stale UI). Leave it untouched unless it blocks discovery; it is a .cjs Node script, not picked up by python unittest discover, so it will not affect the Python run.

Run the full verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (expect OK, count = 44 + any tests you added), and node tests/test_ui.cjs (expect exit 0). Fix any failures caused by the Name wheel removal.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests reports OK (at least the original 44 tests plus the new backward-compat test(s)), with no failures or errors.
node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 and its output no longer references spinning the standalone Name wheel, while STILL asserting the To Die sit-out draw renders.
test_ui.cjs contains a new assertion proving the tabs/rooms no longer include a 'wheel'/'Name wheel' entry and that no 'Name your fate' screen is produced for a navigable tab.
A test proves a backup containing a populated `wheel` object still validates and loads, and that a backup missing `wheel` validates with the default wheel.
The added/modified tests actually exercise the changed code paths (they would fail if the Name wheel were still navigable, or if validate() rejected the wheel field).
findings:
Updated both test suites to match the removed Name wheel (FEAT-002) while keeping the To Die sit-out draw and old-backup load coverage intact. TEST COUNTS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests => Ran 45 tests, OK (was 44; +1 new backward-compat test). node tests/test_ui.cjs => exit 0. node --check static/app.js => OK. tests/test_ui.cjs changes: - To Die sit-out assertions reconciled to the new reality: after r2-done the assertion now checks tab==='sitout' (there is no more wheelMode); dropped the `assert wheelMode==='round2'`. The sit-out draw content assertions are KEPT: sitoutWheelPage() still asserts the sit-out player names and 'Two sit out. Six play.'. The second sitoutWheelPage() call now sets tab='sitout' instead of wheelMode='round2'. - REMOVED the deleted-Name-wheel exercise blocks: the block that set wheelMode='free' and asserted wheelModeTabs()/data-wheel-mode tabs, and the block that forced randomIndex via crypto.getRandomValues and called spinWheel() asserting wheelLast / no-API-call. The r1 fixture load that those blocks relied on was retained (minus the wheel.text seed and wheelMode='free') so the unrelated To Live per-game split assertions (teams-grid, Team A/B, team-score, ten goal inputs, r1-reroll, no per-player team select, no Assign-teams/r1-reset/r1-wheel) still run unchanged. - ADDED Name-wheel-removal navigation coverage: reads the top-level `tabs` array via vm.runInContext and asserts no entry keyed 'wheel' nor labelled 'Name wheel'; calls renderRoom() (which writes #monitors) and asserts the #monitors innerHTML has a surviving data-open="settings" tile but NO data-open="wheel" tile and no 'Name your fate'/'NAME
YOUR FATE.' text; loops every navigable tab, renders its screen (settings/round1/round2/final/overview), and asserts none produce a 'Name your fate' screen or a data-wheel-mode mode tab. Also asserts typeof wheelPage/spinWheel/wheelModeTabs/randomIndex/wheelMode/wheelLast are all 'undefined'. These fail if the Name wheel were still navigable. - Updated the console.log summary lines to drop 'plain name draw' wording and add a Name-wheel-removal line. test_browser.cjs left untouched. tests/test_tournament.py changes: - KEPT and did not weaken test_wheel_large_lists_migration_and_validation, test_legacy_round2_archive_and_current_save_preservation, and the HTTP persistence/revision test (engine.py unchanged, so they pass as-is). - ADDED Rules.test_removed_name_wheel_backward_compat: builds new_state() and asserts wheel defaults to {'text':'','remove_winner':False} and validates at version 4; sets a populated s['wheel']={'text':'Aaron\nGhost\nJay','remove_winner':True}, round-trips through json.dumps/loads, validate()s and asserts the wheel object survives unchanged, then runs evaluate() without error; and asserts a backup dict with the 'wheel' key deleted still validates and defaults the inert wheel. This fails if validate() ever rejected or stripped the wheel field. No engine.py or static/app.js changes were needed in FEAT-003.
